[P2] Validate empty wire subtypes before normalization

The HTTP handler parses updates through `OperationUpdate.from_dict()`, whose `data.get("SubType") or None` converts an explicit `"SubType": ""` into `None`. This branch then skips validation, so an otherwise valid checkpoint succeeds and advances its token instead of returning 400. The new empty-string test constructs `OperationUpdate` directly and misses this path. Validate the supplied wire value before normalization, while preserving support for an omitted subtype, and cover rejection through the HTTP request path.
